text: Claim CLM-1001. Insured: Ravi Mehta. Policy HM-55821 (home). Date of loss 14 Sep 2026. Water from a burst pipe in the kitchen damaged flooring and lower cabinets. Adjuster Neha Kapoor visited on 17 Sep 2026. Estimated repair cost Rs 1,85,000. Deductible Rs 10,000. No prior claims in the last 3 years. Recommended: approve repair, pay Rs 1,75,000 after deductible.

Claim CLM-1002. Insured: Anita Rao. Policy MT-90412 (motor). Date of loss 02 Oct 2026. Rear-end collision at a signal in Pune; third party admitted fault. Bumper and tail lamp replaced at an authorised garage for Rs 42,500. Police report not filed. Recovery from third-party insurer to be pursued. Status: pending recovery.

Claim CLM-1003. Insured: Kiran Textiles Pvt Ltd. Policy FR-30077 (fire). Date of loss 21 Aug 2026. Short circuit in the warehouse destroyed 340 bales of cotton. Surveyor Arjun Sethi assessed the loss at Rs 27,60,000. Sum insured Rs 25,00,000, so the claim is capped. Under-insurance noted. Recommended: pay Rs 25,00,000.

Claim CLM-1004. Insured: Farhan Ali. Policy HL-11893 (health). Admitted 05 Oct 2026, discharged 09 Oct 2026, for appendectomy at City Care Hospital. Bill Rs 1,12,300; room rent exceeded the sub-limit by Rs 8,000 per day for 4 days, so a proportionate deduction applies. Approved amount Rs 81,300.

Claim CLM-1005. Insured: Meera Iyer. Policy TR-44120 (travel). Baggage delayed 52 hours on arrival in Singapore on 11 Sep 2026. Receipts for essentials total SGD 310. Policy pays up to SGD 250 for delays over 24 hours. Recommended: pay SGD 250.

Claim CLM-1006. Insured: Sunil Verma. Policy MT-77310 (motor). Vehicle reported stolen on 28 Sep 2026 in Jaipur. FIR filed the same day. Insured declared value Rs 6,40,000. Investigation by Priya Nair found the vehicle was used commercially, which the private policy excludes. Recommended: repudiate.

Claim CLM-1007. Insured: Lakshmi Foods. Policy BI-62004 (business interruption). Power outage after a transformer failure stopped production for 6 days from 03 Oct 2026. Waiting period is 72 hours. Claimed loss of gross profit Rs 9,00,000 for 6 days. Payable period is 3 days after waiting period. Recommended: pay Rs 4,50,000 subject to audit.

Claim CLM-1008. Insured: Deepak Joshi. Policy HM-60219 (home). Burglary on 19 Oct 2026; laptop and jewellery stolen. FIR filed on 20 Oct 2026. Claimed Rs 2,30,000. Jewellery not separately declared, and the policy limits undeclared jewellery to Rs 50,000. Laptop invoice Rs 78,000. Recommended: pay Rs 1,28,000.
